caption: This shio ramen boasts a clear, light broth with visible noodles and toppings. Nori, chashu, menma, and naruto are artfully arranged atop, in a white bowl on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle scratches with glossy reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with golden-brown sear and visible marbling on its surface.
Dark, crinkled nori seaweed with irregular, frayed edges and a slightly glossy surface.
The shio (salt) broth is light golden, clear, and glossy, with visible noodles and scattered green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with irregular shapes and visible fibrous texture.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
Naruto fish cake: white, fluted, circular with pink spiral swirl on top.
